affenstark.evidence: HABA/Habermaaß 4367, copyright 1996, original multilingual Affenstark/Mighty Monkey/Singeries booklet. English section on PDF pages 3–4 read in full: Carla/Alfons, ten bananas, beam, two starting jungle counters, die actions, two/three-counter success, collapse penalty and nine-counter victory. Canonical selection starts at Mighty Monkey and includes the complete English rules; original other-language pages retained. OCR imperfections remain; original scan is the authority.

aficionado.evidence: Original French Cocktail Games/Martin Bertran Aficionado rules, all four numbered rule-card faces visible on one scan (PDF page 2; archive advertisement page 1 excluded). All four cards inspected visually: 45 double-sided cards, three phrase beginnings read with pauses, exact combined endings, seven-point victory, reader rotation/hints/retry and Olé team variant. Whole-page OCR failed; cropped card-column OCR is still imperfect, so consult the legible original image for exact wording. This is a usable original rules file, not a claim of flawless transcription.

aquatika.evidence: Alexandre Droit/Jeux FK 2016 Aquatika original French rules sheet. Nine pieces per player (three sharks/octopuses/flying fish), own nine-square setup, forward/sideways/diagonal movement without retreat, covering/carrying prey, shark eating including own pieces, straight-axis multiple fish jumps and arrival at own-color opponent goal. Main sheet and diagrams inspected; fresh OCR replaces garbled embedded text. Original PDF retained, including the archive cover.

bermude.evidence: Complete French Bermude rules sheet for two/three/four players: 9/13/18 triangular tiles, nine marbles per player, dispersed initial placement, connected-chain movement, moving vacated triangles, all-own-marble connection victory and optional votes/majority/minority/removal. Correct mutable triangular-board marble game. Original scan readable; OCR column order and diagrams require consulting the PDF.

bull-s-eye-ball.evidence: Hasbro 2003 French Hot Shot/Hot Shots instructions for the electronic Bulls-Eye Ball trampoline game, not an unrelated Hot Shot. Full foldout covers assembly/buttons/scoring, 30-second challenge, 25-point race, bullseye-until-ten-misses mode and practice/reset. Original PDF inspected through the complete modes; OCR sometimes confuses 3 with 8, so original numeric rules remain authoritative. No rotating-target claim certified.

clomping-creatures.evidence: Complete French HABA Animal Mystère/Clomping Creatures chapter, printed pages 12–16, Emely Brand/Thies Schwarz. Correct BGG alias: tactile animal-guessing with 24 path cards, 24 riddle cards, board and snake marker; setup, tracing footsteps on another player’s back without speech, correct/incorrect guesses, card awards, empty-deck end and cooperative ten-card variant. Not a creature-movement/dice game. French chapter read in full and original heading inspected; specific summary contradictions recorded separately.

gipsy-king.evidence: Complete French Cwali Gipsy King rules credited to Corné van Moorsel and translator William Attia: all two-to-five-player setup/landscape, turn-order queue and passing, ascending first half and descending second half, caravan-group triangular scores, ranked fish-majority scoring/ties, double placements, two/three-player exceptions and final total. Resolves earlier two-player-only/diagram-download hold. Original two-page rules and illustrations retained after archive cover; OCR may misread numbers/columns.

gute-freunde.evidence: French De bons amis/Good Friends rules adaptation for the correct frog/lily-pad treasure game; tactile component descriptions are explicit additions for accessibility. Nine pads, four frogs, position-dependent number of dice, gold ring leader, exact treasure arrival, reciprocal gifts, final coin distribution and gold-three/silver-one scoring/ties are all present. Complete five-page rules read. This is a matching French adaptation, not a certified untouched HABA publisher original.

i-am-i-do.evidence: Original Tactic 01738 French Qui es-tu ? Que fais-tu ? rules for I Am, I Do. Complete setup of 50/50 character/action cards, two colored dice, actor’s two-stage mime and combined-answer requirement, independent spinner movement, roulette-space variants including make-someone-laugh, exact-finish win and simplified children’s rules. Main text readable; corrupt decorative-font heading retained in extraction but original PDF readable.

mister-zero.evidence: Complete French Mister Zero instructions, copyright 1985 dacapo spiele, credited to Wilfried Bauer/Rudolf Schweikert. Correct autonomous lowest-number-path game: 20 bridges/two ten-token sets, central placement restrictions/zero exception, rightmost tie rule, no reused bridge, control-point collection, stalled ending and most-token victory, plus tournament/example diagrams. Original rule copy archived by François Haffner. Source designer credit conflicts with summary metadata; no full summary audit.

rsvp.evidence: Original French RSVP/Scrabble upright two-sided crossword rules, copyright 1966/1968 Production and Marketing/Spear. Full foldout includes initial center letter, alternating one-letter placement/valid partial words, using the reverse side, word completion/scoring, 15-point challenges, no passing, agreed target (usually 100, alternatives 50/25) and examples. Correct vertical letter-block game, not an unrelated RSVP title. OCR examples/tables are imperfect; original scan is readable.

grave-robbers-from-outer-space.evidence: Complete French Les Pilleurs de Tombes de l’Espace rules for original 2001 Grave Robbers from Outer Space, Stephen Tassie/Sparechange/Z-Man, French edition Le 7ème Cercle with Neko/John Berk credits. All main rules read: six-card hand, movie title, characters/props/locations/creatures/SFX, attacks/counters, Roll the Credits/deck exhaustion and title-word bonus scoring. Archive file credits fan scan/OCR/corrections; original PDF bytes retained. Two imposition spreads are read in booklet order (1,2,3,4) in canonical text, rather than the file’s cover/last-page ordering.

geoprimo.evidence: Complete French Geoprimo main rules, Selecta 3063/Günter Burkhardt, PDF pages 1–2 (printed 17–18); remaining five landmark-background pages retained in original seven-page booklet. Map puzzle, 42 cards in three difficulties, continent pawns/white shared-continent pawn, simultaneous spotting, two-pawn limit, correct/wrong awards, six-color collection or exhausted-card ending. Native rules read and title/components checked. Player-count wording differs within the source (2–6 headline, 2–5 info box); recovery does not resolve that discrepancy or certify background geography claims.

razzo-raketo.evidence: Original multilingual Razzo Raketo booklet, Steffen Bogen/Michael Menzel. Complete English contents block on PDF page 2 and rightmost English column on pages 3–9 selected; other languages remain in the unchanged nine-page original. Full setup, hidden spaceships, choosing a co-pilot, twice-count-to-ten search, reserve pile, one/two astronaut bonuses, one-pass deck/reserve ending/ties and children’s variants read. Same physical hide-and-seek game; illustrations and exact geometry remain in PDF.

gootmu.evidence: Complete six-page French translation by Jean-Marc Tribet of Tom Jolly/Jolly Games 1992 G.O.O.T.M.U.; translator credit and author-site reference explicit, translation authorization not independently established. Full equipment/setup by player count, adversary placement, collect-three victory, exact die movement, obstacles/items/carry limit, six/power-token tile rotation, wraparound, trapped squares, monster, interactions and complete English-board-text glossary are present. Native first-page font encoding was unusable; fresh OCR of all pages supplies readable text. Original PDF remains authoritative for numbers/diagrams.

arcanor.evidence: Complete original French Grand V Arcanor four-page booklet, Michaël Aguilar: 12 nesting cylinders in four sizes per side, paired starting setup, step/uncover/next-size capture, full-container restriction, inspecting own pieces, protected/immobile arriving pieces and twelve-visible-point victory. Both original JPEG spreads visually read. Local PDF assembles their four panels in booklet order 1–4 for convenience; it is not an original publisher PDF. Both original JPEG bytes/URLs and hashes are retained separately. OCR checked against readable originals; exact diagrams remain authoritative.

baston.evidence: Original Jeux Actuels 1987 Baston, Pierre Cléquin/Bruno Faidutti, correct French suburban-bar tactical brawl (not Bastogne). Public ZIP contains complete 20-page rules, eight-page scenarios, two-page character sheets and three-page reference tables. All four PDF members retained unchanged; local 33-page PDF concatenates them in that order. Core identity/contents and rules coverage checked across setup, 15-turn/scenario goals, character allocation, programmed sequences/rounds, movement/facing/falling, attacks/wounds/stun, fast/slow actions and equipment; scenario/charts included rather than substituted by an aid. OCR appendix pages 19–20 regenerated after 180-degree rotation; maps/tables/number recognition remain imperfect, original scans are authoritative. Not an untouched single publisher PDF.

ast-rix-et-la-potion-magique.reason: File is archive cover plus two short box/reference panels titled Quelques bases du jeu Astérix, not a full gameplay manual. Main card/space procedures remain unavailable.

deconnaissance.evidence: Original French Déconnaissance instructions by Patrick Sébastien, full single rule sheet after archive cover.
